{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is -999.0 (sentinel value)
valid_baseline = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the mean of valid baseline biomarker values
mean_valid_baseline = valid_baseline.mean()

mean_valid_baseline"}
